notes:
v1.0.36 — five changes in one release (one of them a critical crash fix).

1) CRITICAL — fixed the crash on joining worlds/servers (bundled FPS Boost 1.0.12, game-side).
   ClientChunkCacheMixin.accessOk() was a non-private static method without @Unique, which
   Mixin rejects at apply time — an InvalidMixinException during ClientboundLoginPacket
   handling caused the "Network Protocol Error" disconnect / freeze on world and server
   joins. The helpers are now @Unique, mixins.json is required:false (a version-drift
   mixin failure only disables that module instead of crashing login), and the mod logs
   startup diagnostics (MC version, loader, mod version, detected Sodium/C2ME/Iris).

2) Reliable auto-relaunch after updates. The old one-line PowerShell helper could die
   silently — the launcher showed "Relaunching..." then never reopened. Now a real .ps1
   helper is written to disk and spawned DETACHED BEFORE the launcher exits, with absolute
   paths, per-step logging to relaunch.log, a ~3s settle, a check that the updated exe
   exists, retries while the file is locked, and a RELAUNCH_FAILED.txt recovery note if it
   can never start. "Relaunching..." only appears after the helper is confirmed running.

3) Premium startup + redesigned Downloads.
   Startup: the wake-up sequence (logo reveal, purple glow, particles) now respects new
   Settings → Appearance → Startup Experience toggles (Startup Animation / Startup Sound),
   and plays a soft Aurora startup cue. Downloads: complete redesign — every item is a card
   with the real mod artwork, live progress/speed/ETA, grouped into In progress / Completed /
   Failed, with a summary bar and Retry for failures.

4) Enhanced "Check for Updates" (Settings + sidebar arrow). Clicking it now opens a polished
   modal: real elapsed timer, indeterminate orbit animation (never a fake percentage),
   Update available (current → new version, real duration, expandable release notes,
   Update Now / Remind Me Later / Cancel), You're up to date, and a proper failure state
   with Retry — the check engine is untouched, one request at a time.

5) CurseForge returns — securely, with no key in the launcher. The API key lives only on
   YOUR OWN backend proxy (new backend/cf-proxy folder: zero-dependency Node server, key as
   a server-side CF_API_KEY env var). Paste the proxy URL in Settings → Advanced → CurseForge
   proxy URL, and the new CurseForge tab in Mods (and resource packs / shaders) browses,
   installs and updates exactly like Modrinth. No proxy configured? A clear setup card
   explains it. Modrinth is untouched; the key never reaches your PC or this repository.
